definitions.full: H5077. nadah or nada [ נָדָא ] verb drive away, thrust aside (|| form of נדה , q. v., or textual error; Ethiopic drive cattle, etc.); — only Hiph`il Imperfect 3masculine singular י מֵאַחֲרֵי אֶתיִֿשְׂרָאֵל ֗֗֗ ׳וידא 2Kin 17:21 Kt (Qr וַיַדַּח √ נדח Hiph`il ). I. [ נָדָה ] verb Pi`el put away, exclude (Late Hebrew Pi`el ( excommunicate ) Hithpa`el Niph`al; Assyrian nadû , throw , overthrow , destroy , etc., Dl HWB 448 f. ); — Pi`el Participle רַע לְיוֺם הַמְֿנַדִּים Amos 6:3 they that thrust off the evil day (i.e. refuse to think of it); literal מְנַדֵּיכֶם Isa 66:5 thrust away, exclude from association in worship (on usage see Che). II. נדה (√ of following; compare Arabic be moist, moistened , and also betide, befal ; rain, dew , and also bounty, liberality, a gift , Lane 3030 ).
